title: Mill Creek Bridge, Spanning Mill Creek at State Route No. 6, Smyrna, Kent County, DE
notes: Significance: The Mill Creek Bridge, one of three of its kind currently extant in Delaware, is an early representative example of a composite slab deck bridge, combining concrete and laminated timber.
Unprocessed Field note material exists for this structure: N1497
